finite_completion.requirement: some finite stage proves A_Z = 0 on the completed ledger

fixed_ledger.requirement: the same completed A_Z is dominated by budgets B_n with tr(B_n)->0

exhaustive_ledger.requirement: partial ledgers dominate A_Z up to tails T_n with tr(B_n)+tr(T_n)->0

moving_ledger_support_only.failure: moving finite ledgers have no tail/exhaustivity bridge to a completed A_Z

failed_tail.failure: the omitted zero-side tail does not vanish

failed_visibility.failure: the zero readout does not separate the fixed locus

failed_budget_collapse.failure: EF/source/coercivity obstruction terms fail to vanish
